reason: The 20-F filing for Abivax SA (ABVX) does not contain any Total Addressable Market (TAM) disclosure. The filing is focused on financial statements, equity transactions, intangible assets, property/plant/equipment, leases, financial instruments, and share-based compensation. There are no sections discussing market opportunity, market size estimates, or addressable patient populations that would constitute a company-disclosed TAM. The company operates in healthcare/biotech with clinical-stage programs (ABX464 and ABX196 mentioned), but no market sizing data was published by the company in this filing.
